verdict.rationale: Extend's pricing page lists 'BYOC (your VPC) and Hybrid deployments' as an offering. That covers the core of running the stack inside the customer's own infrastructure. Configurable zero data retention, including with AI subprocessors, supports the case of documents not leaving that infrastructure. The VPC claim, however, is a single pricing-page bullet with no deployment documentation, and nothing shows a fully self-hosted or on-prem option. Missing for 10: deployment docs for BYOC/Hybrid (architecture, what runs where, model hosting), evidence of a fully self-hosted/air-gapped option, independent or hands-on corroboration.
